events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I have fifteen people sitting here waiting and I need this sorted out right now.

I'm sorry, that's a frustrating situation, especially with everyone waiting. I'll help get this sorted out.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. Your order ID, if you have it handy

Okay, fine. My name is Lucia Ferraro. My phone is +1 415-555-0133 and the email is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example. The order number is 5105. Can you please just hurry up and get this refunded? Nothing showed up at all.

events.text:
Thank you, Lucia. Your identity is verified, and I've pulled up order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza.

Because no items arrived, this order qualifies for a full refund of $131.25 to your Visa ending in 4242. That amount is above the limit I can approve myself, so I've escalated the case to a human specialist (escalation ID ESC-700). They will follow up with you within 24 hours.

I know you need this now, and I'm sorry I can't approve the refund directly. Please keep your order details handy for the specialist. If the food ever shows up, or you want to talk to someone about it sooner, reply here.
Can't you just refund it now? I've got fifteen people waiting and a 24 hour wait is not going to help me today.

I understand how urgent this is, and I'm sorry. I can't issue the $131.25 refund myself because it's over my limit, and the specialist's review is the only route to that refund.

Here's what I can do right now:

- **Contact Big Slice Pizza directly.** They can see whether the order left the restaurant and may be able to send food quickly.
- **Keep ESC-700 open.** The specialist will follow up within 24 hours with the refund decision.
- **Ask for a person now.** If you want a human to look at this sooner, I can add that request to the case. I can't promise a faster response, though.

Is there anything else I can help with on this order?

Okay, fine. I'll try calling Big Slice myself, since nobody has told me anything useful yet. Please make sure the specialist knows nothing arrived and reception on floor 3 has nothing. I need this closed out, so I'll wait for their follow-up.

I've already included in ESC-700 that no items arrived at all, along with the delivery address and the full list of items. I can't add notes to an existing case, so I can't add the detail about the floor 3 reception desk. If you find out anything from the restaurant or reception, reply here and I'll pass it along with the escalation.

Good luck with the call, and I hope your guests get fed soon. The specialist will follow up within 24 hours about the refund.
